title: Stop Auto Memory from retrying low-signal sessions indefinitely

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly describes a logic defect in Auto Memory session extraction tracking, where candidate sessions surfaced to the agent but skipped (not read via read_file) remain unprocessed and are repeatedly surfaced in subsequent extraction runs. It provides reproduction context, target file (packages/core/src/services/memoryService.ts), expected behavior, and acceptance criteria.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires localized updates in packages/core/src/services/memoryService.ts to record skipped candidate sessions in extraction state so they are not endlessly retried, along with corresponding unit test coverage in packages/core/src/services/memoryService.test.ts.

summary.problem: Auto Memory extraction runs treat candidate sessions as processed only when successfully read via the read_file tool call. Low-signal sessions surfaced as candidates but intentionally skipped are not recorded as processed, causing them to resurface repeatedly on every background extraction interval.
summary.root_cause: In memoryService.ts, runExtraction populates processedSessions solely from processedSessionKeys, which are added during successful read_file tool execution events. Surfaced candidate sessions that the agent chooses not to read remain marked as unprocessed and continue to be selected as [NEW] candidate sessions in future runs.
summary.context: Background extraction runs execute on a 30-minute interval. Repeatedly selecting and evaluating low-signal candidate sessions wastes background execution cycles and LLM tokens.

steps: Update ExtractionRun and ExtractionState metadata in packages/core/src/services/memoryService.ts to record skipped or attempted candidate sessions alongside processed sessions.
In runExtraction, track candidate sessions that were surfaced but not read via read_file, distinguishing skipped sessions from failed reads.

Update isSessionVersionProcessed or candidate selection logic so that skipped or attempted low-signal candidate sessions are excluded from being repeatedly surfaced as new candidates in buildSessionIndex.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Candidate sessions surfaced to the extraction agent that are intentionally skipped (not read via read_file) are recorded as skipped/attempted in extraction state and are not resurfaced as new candidate sessions on subsequent extraction runs.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/core/src/services/memoryService.test.ts simulating buildSessionIndex and runExtraction with candidate sessions where no read_file tool call is executed.
Assert that the extraction run state properly records the candidate sessions as skipped or attempted.
Assert that subsequent calls to buildSessionIndex do not mark the skipped sessions as [NEW] candidate sessions.
